description: Spec 008 (iteration 4, Annex A levers B.2.2 + B.2.3, decision 23): the models change, the problem does not. Velocity outputs (log range, vx, vy scaled by the top of the target speed range, 10.29 m/s; course and speed derived) and the derived feature set (13 channels: bearing rate, its validity flag, bearing-line intercept). Otherwise the iteration-3 configuration from scratch (2 x 128 stacked recurrent layers, loss_weight_speed 4 on each velocity component, max_epochs 150, patience 6, same seeds), on iteration 3's three-leg problem (generator 0.3.0, configs/iter4-ranges.json identical to iter3). Dataset seed 205: its own test split decides G2. Scored on validation first, with the iteration-3 models beside (validation rule FR-006).
